abort.no_uuid: Kodi instance does not have a unique ID. This is most likely due to an old Kodi version (17.x or below). You can configure the integration manually or upgrade to a more recent Kodi version.

data_description.password: The password of the Kodi web server.
data_description.username: The username of the Kodi web server. Kodi uses `kodi` by default.

credentials.description: Enter the username and password of the Kodi web server, as set under **Settings** > **Services** > **Control** in Kodi.

discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add Kodi (`{name}`) to Home Assistant?
discovery_confirm.title: Discovered Kodi

reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for Kodi at {host} are no longer valid. Enter the username and password of the Kodi web server, as set under **Settings** > **Services** > **Control** in Kodi.
reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the system hosting your Kodi server.
data_description.port: The port of the Kodi web server, set in the same Kodi menu.
data_description.ssl: Connect over HTTPS. Turn this on if you reach Kodi over HTTPS, like with **Enable SSL** on in Kodi or behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.

user.description: Enter the connection details of the Kodi web server. In Kodi, turn on **Allow remote control via HTTP** under **Settings** > **Services** > **Control**.

data_description.ws_port: The JSON-RPC port of Kodi, 9090 by default. You can change it in `advancedsettings.xml`.

ws_port.description: To connect over WebSocket, turn on **Allow remote control from applications on this system** under **Settings** > **Services** > **Control** in Kodi. If Home Assistant connects from another system, also turn on **Allow remote control from applications on other systems**. If Kodi does not show these settings, or you do not use WebSocket, leave the port empty.

album_not_found.message: No album matching {media_name} was found in the Kodi music library.

artist_not_found.message: No artist matching {artist_name} was found in the Kodi music library.

invalid_displaytime.message: Display time {displaytime} is not a number of at least 1500 milliseconds.

invalid_library_id.message: Media ID {media_id} is not a Kodi library ID.

invalid_media_id.message: Media ID {media_id} is not a number.

invalid_media_type.message: Media type {media_type} is not supported. Use `SONG` or `ALBUM`.

invalid_season_id.message: Season ID {media_id} is not a Kodi TV show ID and a season number, separated by a slash.

invalid_seek_position.message: Seek position {position} is not a finite number.

missing_artist_name.message: Enter an artist name to add all albums of an artist.

missing_media.message: Enter a media ID or a media name to add a song.

no_active_player.message: Shuffle cannot be set while {name} is not playing anything.

no_albums.message: Artist {artist_name} has no albums in the Kodi music library.

notify_failed.message: Unable to send the notification to Kodi. Is Kodi online?

notify_rejected.message: Kodi replied to the notification with an error or an invalid response: {error}

song_not_found.message: No song matching {media_name} was found in the Kodi music library.

add_to_playlist.description: Adds music to the default playlist (i.e. playlistid=0).

artist_name.description: Optional artist name for filtering media.
artist_name.name: Artist name

media_id.description: Unique ID of the media entry to add (`songid` or albumid`). If not defined, Media name and Artist name are needed to search the Kodi music library.
media_id.name: Media ID

media_name.description: Optional media name for filtering media. Can be 'ALL' when Media type is 'ALBUM' and Artist name is specified, to add all songs from one artist.
media_name.name: Media name

media_type.description: Media type identifier. It must be one of 'SONG' or 'ALBUM'.
media_type.name: Media type

add_to_playlist.name: Add to playlist

call_method.description: Calls a Kodi JSONRPC API method with optional parameters. Results of the Kodi API call will be redirected in a Home Assistant event: `kodi_call_method_result`.

method.description: Name of the Kodi JSONRPC API method to be called.
method.name: Method

call_method.name: Call method
